page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance running on KVM hypervisors. Powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 x86_64 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, this instance features 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Cache resources include 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache per core, and a 33 MB L3 cache. Instruction set support includes AVX and AVX-512 foundation flags alongside AES encryption. It lacks local storage and dedicated GPU hardware, relying on attached block storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance exhibits distinct multi-core scaling alongside modest single-core throughput. Single-threaded metrics rank lower, as shown by stress-ng single-core tests, gzip compression, and single-core Geekbench scores. Conversely, parallel execution across all 32 vCPUs achieves solid average results in stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and software compilation benchmarks. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reaches 119.7 GB/sec. Operational benchmarks confirm steady middle-tier capacity for key service roles, yielding 23.48 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and 14.04 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

From an operational perspective, the ecs.g5ne.8xlarge delivers standard resource density for parallel compute tasks without requiring higher-cost GPU compute or integrated local NVMe drives. The 128 GB memory capacity provides sufficient head-room for mid-sized datasets and in-memory caches. Recommended workload deployments include general web application serving, Redis caching nodes, continuous integration build runners, middle-tier relational databases, and multi-threaded data processing.

This instance provides balanced vCPU-to-memory resources suited for general-purpose application servers, distributed caching, software build runners, and enterprise web applications.
